interpretation: Fällda totals are calculated by summing ShotTotal across all TableDataFormatted ÄJO rows within each AFO; avskjutningsmål is the sum of AssignedTotal. The portal's visible Summa row uses a two-part display; its leading value is not the animal total. Full raw area rows and the HTML Summa row are preserved in each immutable AFO snapshot. Totals are cumulative reported values for the selected hunting season, not exact daily kill events.
